[[File:Civ_Darklancers_TIE_Interceptor.jpg|thumb|250px|Civ Darklancer's [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]]]]
'''Civ Darklancer''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Darklancer held the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]] and served as leader of the Imperial [[Yavin blockade|blockade]] of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], where they flew a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Civ Darklancer appeared appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Major Civ Darklancer was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
